system.description:
Range 10ft. Raises skeletons or zombies from bones or corpses; total HD raised = your level, each with the HD it had in life (max 6 HD each). They obey your spoken commands within 60ft and stay active for 1 hour per level, then fall inert; you control at most 2 × your level in HD at once (oldest go inert first). A Necromancer's raised undead use Undead Mastery and Soul Tax instead; any other caster uses this paragraph. Cast reversed (Rest the Dead): Range 30ft; one undead of Level up to your level is destroyed; Will negates. Material: a black onyx worth 25 gp per HD of each undead raised, consumed.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Cleric, Necromancer, Witch
